principle_violations.reason: The Order class manages items, quantities, and prices, violating SRP by handling both order management and payment status. The PaymentProcessor subclasses (PaypalPaymentProcessor, CreditCardPaymentProcessor, DebitCardPaymentProcessor) contain payment logic irrelevant to certain payment methods but still modify order status.
principle_violations.suggestion: Refactor to separate concerns: Create individual Order management and Payment management classes. Extract payment functionalities into a dedicated hierarchy without affecting Orders directly.

principle_violations.reason: The PaymentProcessor class forces implementation of auth_sms, even for classes where it is not relevant, violating ISP.
principle_violations.suggestion: Split the PaymentProcessor interface into smaller, more specific interfaces. Create an AuthSupport interface for authentication-related methods, allowing payment processors to implement what they need.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
